name: Integration Failures
query:
SELECT
	i.integration_request_service AS "Channel:Data:140",
	i.status AS "Status:Data:100",
	LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(i.error, ''), i.output, ''), 160) AS "Reason:Data:520",
	COUNT(*) AS "Count:Int:80",
	MIN(i.creation) AS "First:Datetime:160",
	MAX(i.creation) AS "Last:Datetime:160"
FROM `tabIntegration Request` i FORCE INDEX (creation)
WHERE i.creation >= %(from_date)s AND i.creation < %(to_date)s + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND i.status IN ('Failed', 'Cancelled')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 4 DESC
